verdict: Yes, with a clear style. Chokhat pitched affordable designer home decor on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Renters and first-time homeowners want decor that looks designed but costs little, and they buy often.
angle: Affordable decor such as wall art, planters, cushions and lamps sells to young renters and new homeowners. Social media and room-makeover content drive discovery. Keep costs low with cluster sourcing and flat-pack designs that ship safely.
